column1: # Mario Kart World (Switch 2): base v0 (SDK 19.3.3) and update 1.8.0 (SDK 21.4.0).
# The default package and committed shader tables are for 1.8.0.
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl / gsys, Phive, Havok, Pia), NVN2 (Ampere shaders).
# Packed from a dump folder (base/, updates/<version>/) with scripts/pack_dump.py. Shaders: Shader/*.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.bfsha.zs (BNSH with Ampere code).
# The base game's subsdk0 is a Mono runtime (nn::ecli). In 1.8.0, subsdk0 is the movie player and subsdk1 a C library.
# Each build row names its own modules, and the host loads those of main's build (main.c profile_modules)
# The Switch 2 leaves games 9 GB of its 12 GB (Donkey Kong Bananza's figure). The NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on:
# nninitStartup still sets a heap of pool - used (SetHeapSize 0x1dbc00000, 7.43 GB, with the 9 GB pool; 1.8.0 asks 0x1de400000, 7.47 GB, by pull request #1116), and nnMain allocates a fixed
# 7.04 GB block from it: 256 MB in front + 4 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 8 GB heap region
# Lib/ shaders use the default "other" package group in the 1.8.0 tables.
# agl wraps its clears in render conditions on Donkey Kong Bananza and Splatoon Raiders; the same library here, to be confirmed on this game
# Unflushed CPU height/normal tiles, including initial data and late streamed writes.
